passage.label: Al-Baqarah — Adam narrative: vicegerency, knowledge taught, angels' prostration, Iblis refusal, Garden dwelling, prohibition, slip, expulsion, repentance, guidance promise

arabicExcerpts.text: وَإِذۡ قَالَ رَبُّكَ لِلۡمَلَـٰٓئِكَةِ إِنِّي جَاعِلٞ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ خَلِيفَةٗۖ قَالُوٓاْ أَتَجۡعَلُ فِيهَا مَن يُفۡسِدُ فِيهَا وَيَسۡفِكُ ٱلدِّمَآءَ وَنَحۡنُ نُسَبِّحُ بِحَمۡدِكَ وَنُقَدِّسُ لَكَۖ قَالَ إِنِّيٓ أَعۡلَمُ مَا لَا تَعۡلَمُونَ
وَعَلَّمَ ءَادَمَ ٱلۡأَسۡمَآءَ كُلَّهَا ثُمَّ عَرَضَهُمۡ عَلَى ٱلۡمَلَـٰٓئِكَةِ فَقَالَ أَنۢبِـُٔونِي بِأَسۡمَآءِ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ إِن كُنتُمۡ صَٰدِقِينَ
قَالُواْ سُبۡحَٰنَكَ لَا عِلۡمَ لَنَآ إِلَّا مَا عَلَّمۡتَنَآۖ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلۡعَلِيمُ ٱلۡحَكِيمُ

قَالَ يَـٰٓـَٔادَمُ أَنۢبِئۡهُم بِأَسۡمَآئِهِمۡۖ فَلَمَّآ أَنۢبَأَهُم بِأَسۡمَآئِهِمۡ قَالَ أَلَمۡ أَقُل لَّكُمۡ إِنِّيٓ أَعۡلَمُ غَيۡبَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَأَعۡلَمُ مَا تُبۡدُونَ وَمَا كُنتُمۡ تَكۡتُمُونَ
وَإِذۡ قُلۡنَا لِلۡمَلَـٰٓئِكَةِ ٱسۡجُدُواْ لِأٓدَمَ فَسَجَدُوٓاْ إِلَّآ إِبۡلِيسَ أَبَىٰ وَٱسۡتَكۡبَرَ وَكَانَ مِنَ ٱلۡكَٰفِرِينَ
وَقُلۡنَا يَـٰٓـَٔادَمُ ٱسۡكُنۡ أَنتَ وَزَوۡجُكَ ٱلۡجَنَّةَ وَكُلَا مِنۡهَا رَغَدًا حَيۡثُ شِئۡتُمَا وَلَا تَقۡرَبَا هَٰذِهِ ٱلشَّجَرَةَ فَتَكُونَا مِنَ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ
فَأَزَلَّهُمَا ٱلشَّيۡطَٰنُ عَنۡهَا فَأَخۡرَجَهُمَا مِمَّا كَانَا فِيهِۖ وَقُلۡنَا ٱهۡبِطُواْ بَعۡضُكُمۡ لِبَعۡضٍ عَدُوّٞۖ وَلَكُمۡ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ مُسۡتَقَرّٞ وَمَتَٰعٌ إِلَىٰ حِينٖ
فَتَلَقَّىٰٓ ءَادَمُ مِن رَّبِّهِۦ كَلِمَٰتٖ فَتَابَ عَلَيۡهِۚ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلتَّوَّابُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
قُلۡنَا ٱهۡبِطُواْ مِنۡهَا جَمِيعٗاۖ فَإِمَّا يَأۡتِيَنَّكُم مِّنِّي هُدٗى فَمَن تَبِعَ هُدَايَ فَلَا خَوۡفٌ عَلَيۡهِمۡ وَلَا هُمۡ يَحۡزَنُونَ
وَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ وَكَذَّبُواْ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَآ أُوْلَـٰٓئِكَ أَصۡحَٰبُ ٱلنَّارِۖ هُمۡ فِيهَا خَٰلِدُونَ

mainSubject.label: Adam narrative: divine appointment of khalifah on earth, angels' objection, teaching of names, prostration command, Iblis's arrogant refusal, Garden dwelling and prohibition, Satan-caused slip, expulsion, Adam's repentance accepted, descent with guidance promise, consequences for disbelief

subordinateSubjects.label: Divine announcement to angels: appointing a khalifah on earth
Angels' objection: will You place one who causes corruption and sheds blood?
Angels' self-description: tasbih and taqdis
Divine response: I know what you do not know
Teaching Adam all the names (al-asma'a kullaha)
Displaying named things to angels and challenging them to identify
Angels' admission: no knowledge except what Allah taught
Affirmation: Allah is al-Aleem al-Hakeem
Adam informed the angels of the names successfully
Divine reminder: knowledge of unseen of heavens and earth, revealed and concealed
Command to angels: prostrate to Adam
All angels prostrated except Iblis
Iblis refused (aba), was arrogant (istakbara), became of the kafireen
Permission to dwell in Garden with spouse, eat freely
Prohibition: do not approach this tree
Consequence of approaching: becoming among the wrongdoers (zalimeen)
Satan caused them to slip (azallahuma ash-shaytan)
Expulsion from Garden; enmity between parties
Earth as dwelling place and provision for a time
Adam received words (kalimat) from his Lord
Allah accepted Adam's repentance (taba alayhi)
Allah is at-Tawwab ar-Raheem
Descent command repeated; guidance will come
Following guidance removes fear and grief
Those who disbelieve and deny signs: companions of Fire eternally

humanConditionsAndSpiritualStates.label: Human capacity for knowledge as distinguishing feature
Angelic acknowledgment of limited knowledge vs. divine omniscience
Arrogance (istikbar) as root cause of Iblis's disobedience
Wrongdoing (zulm) as consequence of transgressing divine boundary
Repentance (tawbah) as divinely enabled recovery mechanism
Freedom from fear and grief as fruit of following guidance

relationships.label: Khalifah appointment establishing human role on earth
Teacher-student dynamic between Allah and Adam
Enmity established between humans and Satan
Covenantal relationship through guidance and obedience

notes: Pass A pilot 3, passage 6/4. Core Adam narrative. Contains first occurrence of khalifah, first prostration command, first tawbah, first shaytan reference in Al-Baqarah.
